description: caseworker hooks. (1) PreToolUse Bash|PowerShell: git commit / git push are judged against the branch state JSON (gate + review records) — both shell tools, because matching only one leaves the other unguarded. (2) PreToolUse Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit: files matching harness.json.protected[] cannot be edited (verification assets, gate scripts). (3) PostToolUse Edit|Write|MultiEdit: md-lint warns (never blocks) on frontmatter / [[link]] / relative .md link / LOG.md line format of the markdown file just written. (4) SessionStart: session-brief injects branch·issue·stage·gate/review freshness·PROGRESS tail·loop status as additionalContext (≤3,500 chars; silent outside a harness project). (5) Stop: when a completeness loop is active for this session (.loop/session.local.json), the stop is blocked and the next round prompt is fed back; verdict comes from loop.mjs on disk.
